Ticket:  C3DEV-697052
Summary: [CLRADD] Introduce custom "text" and "number" filter with recycle bin to clear filter contents
Type:    Development Story
Status:  To Do
Parent:  (none directly; linked sub-task C3DEV-697096 "Analyze ..." has parent C3DEV-695166 "Technical Analysis - CoCap - R26.6/3" - a release container, not a design epic)

As CoCap RE I want to have a user friendly text filter so that searching in our applications get's more comfortable.

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
 * Custom "Text filter" with recycle bin in Clarity Addons
 * Custom "Numeric filter" with recycle bin in Clarity Addons
 * Custom filters documented in Clarity Addons
 * Custom filters used in CoCap applications

## SPECIFICATION

### Custom "Text filter" with recycle bin in Clarity Addons
Back in 2022 our colleague Christian Köberl sent a MR to Clarity:
feat(datagrid): add possibility to clear filters by derkoe · Pull Request #246 · vmware-clarity/ng-clarity
https://github.com/vmware-clarity/ng-clarity/pull/246

But nothing happened in the last 4 years and now we'd like to implement our own solution.

So the goal is simple: we want to implement our own text filter similar to the default Clarity one, just with the recycle bin :)

To take into account:
 * debounce the input - take care to not start filtering right after a keypress
 * only close the filter when user explicitly closes it by clicking on X button
 * persistence and restore of filter values working
 * simple migration from default Clarity to custom Clarity Addons filter

Mockup: screenshot-1.png

### Custom "Numeric filter" with recycle bin in Clarity Addons
The 2nd and last default filter offered by Clarity is the "numeric filter", it has the same problem as the text filter: no recycle bin and a demo of the amount of necessary steps to clear is included in the link to the MR above.

So let's also add a custom numeric filter to Clarity Addons with a recycle bin.

Mockup: screenshot-2.png

### Custom filters documented in Clarity Addons
Of course document the new filters in Clarity Addons with a small demo.

### Custom filters used in CoCap applications
Finally adjust all CoCap applications to use the new filters instead of the default ones.
 * Configuration
 * Scheduler
 * Datahub
 * Systemmanagement
 * Communicator
 * Outputmanager
 * Dashboard

## NOT IN FOCUS
 * list not in focus here

## TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
 * we already have custom Filters like ClrDateFilterComponent, so add 2 new ones for string and number
   * add Trash button ( btn-icon btn-link btn-trash ) → clearFilter().
   * 500ms debounce on input via RxJS.
   * Popover stays open until explicit close — default ClrDatagridFilter behavior, no extra work.
   * Persistence: reuse existing ClrDatagridStatePersistenceModule.
 * Check if some code can be shared within the 4 custom filters
 * Think about a linting rule to automatically set the string filter if no filter is set
